title: Dire Strait
statementMd:
Mickey has been enjoying sailing on the local lake, but now it's the end of the day and it's time to go back to dock to return the rental boat on time.

Find the shortest path from its current location to the one remaining egress point over water, staying within or passing along the coastline of the lake.

The lake is represented as a simple, potentially concave, polygon having vertices at integer coordinates, and with no $3$ consecutive vertices being collinear.

A triangulation of the lake into $(n-2)$ pieces is also provided.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d1747b9b80fc7687c49ed8cd541416c1fbfaa2ba.png)Illustration of Sample Input 1.

## Input

- The number of vertices in the polygon representing the lake, $n$ ($3 \le n \le 100\,000$), and the indices of the two vertices between which to travel, $a$ and $b$ ($1 \le a, b \le n; a \ne b$).
- $n$ further lines, each giving integer coordinates $x_i$ $y_i$ of the $i$th vertex of the polygon ($-10^9 \le x, y \le 10^9$) in anti-clockwise order.
- $(n-2)$ further lines giving a triangulation of the lake. Each line specifies the $1$-based indices of three vertices $u$ $v$ $w$ (in anti-clockwise order).

The given triangles correspond to the polygon, thus cover the lake without any self-overlaps, holes, or other hazards.

## Output

Output the shortest distance from point $a$ to point $b$ without exiting the lake.

The output must be accurate to an absolute or relative error of $10^{-6}$.
statementZhMd:
Mickey 一直在当地的湖上享受航行的乐趣，但现在一天即将结束，他该返回码头，以便按时归还租来的船了。

请找出从他当前所在位置到唯一剩余的水上出口的最短路径，路径必须位于湖内或沿着湖岸。

湖泊由一个简单多边形表示，它可能是凹多边形，各顶点的坐标均为整数，且任意连续的 $3$ 个顶点不共线。

题目还给出了将湖泊划分为 $(n-2)$ 个三角形的三角剖分。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d1747b9b80fc7687c49ed8cd541416c1fbfaa2ba.png)样例输入 1 的示意图。

## 输入格式

- 表示湖泊的多边形的顶点数 $n$（$3 \le n \le 100\,000$），以及行程起点和终点两个顶点的编号 $a$ 和 $b$（$1 \le a, b \le n; a \ne b$）。
- 接下来 $n$ 行，每行给出多边形第 $i$ 个顶点的整数坐标 $x_i$ $y_i$（$-10^9 \le x, y \le 10^9$），顶点按逆时针顺序给出。
- 接下来 $(n-2)$ 行，给出湖泊的一个三角剖分。每行按逆时针顺序给出三个顶点的编号 $u$ $v$ $w$，编号从 $1$ 开始。

给定的三角形恰好构成该多边形，因此它们覆盖整个湖泊，且不存在重叠、空洞或其他异常情况。

## 输出格式

输出从点 $a$ 到点 $b$ 且不离开湖泊的最短距离。

输出的绝对误差或相对误差必须不超过 $10^{-6}$。
